home.duesPlaceholder: Your dues will show here once your society starts using SocietyIQ.

install.title: Add SocietyIQ to your home screen
install.body: Open it like any other app, even with a weak network.
install.iphone: On iPhone: tap the Share button, then "Add to Home Screen".

noSociety.title: Your society has not added you yet
noSociety.body: Ask your society committee to invite you. Then open the link they send you.

money.cannotLoad: Could not load your dues. Check your internet and try again.
money.noFlat: Your flat is not linked yet. Ask your society committee to invite you for your flat.
money.ownerPays: Bills for this flat go to the owner.
money.reportedBody: Your treasurer will check it and confirm. Your receipt will appear under My receipts.
money.badAmount: Enter the amount in rupees, for example 4200
money.needReference: Enter the reference number from your payment app or bank
money.directNote: The money goes straight to your society's own bank account.
money.noUpi: Your society has not added UPI details yet. Ask your treasurer how to pay.
money.iPaidBody: Paid already? Tell us here so your treasurer can confirm it.
money.referenceHelp: The UPI reference or bank UTR from your payment message
money.offline: You are offline. Showing what was last loaded.
